PSI Software SE is a German company that develops software to help manage energy systems, production processes, logistics and infrastructure.
Based in Berlin, the company focuses on automation and digitalization solutions, mainly for the industrial infrastructure.
History
PSI Software AG was founded in 1969 by Hermann Sihn. Over the decades, it has expanded its product portfolio from basic software solutions to advanced systems supporting digital transformation, particularly in energy and manufacturing industries. The company is publicly traded on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.
Market and customers
PSI serves a diverse range of industries, primarily in Europe but also internationally.
